adjudication.depicted_input: Figure 2c's left column labeled 'Input (DAPI)', showing the DAPI nuclear-staining image patches used as the conditioning image for TissueCraftAI's DAPI-to-H&E synthesis route.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible under atlas rules because it visibly shows the actual route-specific input object supplied to the target model: DAPI nuclear-staining image patches labeled as input. A model box or explicit interface is not required when the figure clearly depicts the supplied conditioning image. This supports the DAPI-to-H&E inference route, but not the H&E-conditioned proteomics/transcriptomics routes, whose input object is different and is not shown in this crop.
